name: TM31
description: Destroys barriers like Light Screen and causes damage.

gifts.note: Beat the Dewford Gym Leader (Badge 2). After the battle you get TM Package 2 (a set of TMs that go straight into your TM Case) and a Focus Sash. If your Bag had no room for the Focus Sash, talk to the Leader again.
Just talk to him. The Black Belt in this Sootopolis City house gives you the Brick Break TM the first time you speak to him. The city's houses are shut during the Groudon and Kyogre crisis.
